name: Clackamas River (Lower)
blurb: Portland-area summer floats below Estacada, with a quieter upper run and a busy Barton-to-Carver tube stretch on hot weekends.

sections.notes: The quieter of the two listed floats. Cold water and moving current still demand a properly fitted PFD. Arrange a two-vehicle shuttle between McIver and Barton.

putInAccess.sourceName: Oregon State Marine Board Boat Oregon access inventory
putInAccess.note: The agency marker is by the lower-ramp parking turnaround; the river landing is through the trees. Lower ramp only, not the upper ramp or Estacada Lake.
putInAccess.directions: Use the signed public entrance and designated river access at Milo McIver State Park (Lower Ramp). Check the operator’s current hours and seasonal conditions before arranging the shuttle.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: Oregon State Marine Board Boat Oregon access inventory
takeOutAccess.note: Agency launch record and satellite imagery agree on this riverside access facility. The marker is an approximate facility location, not a surveyed landing edge.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use the signed public entrance and designated river access at Barton Park. Check the operator’s current hours and seasonal conditions before arranging the shuttle.

sections.notes: The busy summer tube stretch, especially on hot weekends. Parking can fill early at Barton and Carver. Arrange a shuttle before launching.

putInAccess.sourceName: Oregon State Marine Board Boat Oregon access inventory
putInAccess.note: Agency launch record and satellite imagery agree on this riverside access facility. The marker is an approximate facility location, not a surveyed landing edge.
putInAccess.directions: Use the signed public entrance and designated river access at Barton Park. Check the operator’s current hours and seasonal conditions before arranging the shuttle.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: Oregon State Marine Board Boat Oregon access inventory
takeOutAccess.note: The agency marker is in the river beside the public ramp. It locates the facility; use the signed ramp entrance, not a GPS line to the water.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use the signed public entrance and designated river access at Carver Park. Check the operator’s current hours and seasonal conditions before arranging the shuttle.

mapAuditNote: Agency source and satellite facility review completed 2026-10-29. Only sections with two documented access sites and a separate section approval are shown; approximate markers do not establish an exact landing or river path.
